title: Returnless Partial Refunds: A Large-Scale Field Experiment in E-Commerce
authors: Lu Fang; Chunhua Wu; Zhe Yuan; Kaifu Zhang
eligible_reason: Large-scale randomized field experiment on returnless partial refunds: buyer-level outcomes regressed on is_testgroup with demographic FE and pre-period controls, plus IV (ivreg2) for the refund offer. No staggered adoption or DiD.
design_notes: stata_code/Mkt_Sci_Table_3.do: reghdfe y is_testgroup gmv_before refund_before register, absorb(create_date_first gender age country_code ...). Tables 4 and 7 use ivreg2 with period as instrument; Table 6 is simple OLS on treatment group.
data_files: refund_longrun_30_1.dta and nine other synthetic .dta files
data_files_note: README: ten synthetic datasets preserving variable names and units; proprietary platform data not shipped.
data_provenance_note: README states the datasets are synthetic and will not reproduce published estimates.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
